question.text: Under IFSCA guidelines (Clause 6.2.3), where a business relationship was established before completing verification and the verification remains uncompleted, after how many days must the Regulated Entity terminate the business relationship?

explanation.text: The Logic: Where a business relationship was established before verification and the verification remains uncompleted, the relationship must be terminated after 120 days. The relationship is suspended at 30 days and terminated at 120 days. The Trap: 30 days is the suspension timeline, not the termination deadline. 60 and 180 days are not prescribed. Note: Two key numbers under Clause 6.2.3 are 30 (suspend) and 120 (terminate).
